They correctly found 1 + 3 = 4, 1 + 3 + 5 = 9, and 1 + 3 + 5 + 7 = 16; the odd/even mix-up was corrected later in the lesson, but the final teach-back was not completed. At home, use a short table of the first five odd-number sums and their matching squares.
